brief: Checks an org chart against three BCEAO governance rules: a board, audit under the board, and a risk function.
detail: It takes a snapshot of the chart when it is built. stzOrgChart.ValidateBCEAOGovernance builds one for you.
receiver: oc = new stzOrgChart("TechCo"); oc.AddExecutiveXT("ceo", "CEO"); oc.AddManagerXT("vp", "VP Sales"); oc.ReportsTo("vp", "ceo"); oc.AddPersonXT("p1", "Alice"); oc.AssignPerson("p1", "ceo"); o1 = new stzOrgChartBCEAOValidator(oc)
